title: Flood Evacuation and Rescue, Pt. 4
description: B-roll of Soldiers helping with flood prevention. Scenes include the last part of an interview with Sgt. 1st Class Staley, Soldiers building a barrier with sandbags and an interview. Part 4 of 4.
